craft_notes: Sthāyin śānta offering. Dash-hold + colon landing on the gift (end-weight). Rejected: refrain 'to you, to you' — single address kept. Read aloud: One held, gift lands.

lines: Past sixfold proof and parting, to the Partless One —
to the Single State of highest aim: our gift, Bhava, to you.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ṣaṭpramāṇīparicchedabhedayoge 'py abhedine paramārthaikabhāvāya baliṃ yāmo bhavāya te

reads_against.argmap: Even in six-valid-means-delimitation-difference yoga: to the undivided. → Offer to undivided Bhava, ultimate truth's one being, beyond the six means.
c1_essence: Milked stainless Śiva-wisdom begged; offering carried to undivided Bhava, ultimate truth's one being.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-vismaya (devotion charged with wonder); sthayibhava utsāha-in-bhakti
